items.source: Helper method to create an interface mixin. For finer control over the generated instance, use a new instance of Mixin instead of this static method. TODO
items.translation: 用于创建接口混合（interface mixin）的辅助方法。若要更精细地控制生成的实例，请使用新的 Mixin 实例代替此静态方法。 TODO

items.source: Mixin allows multiple objects to be combined into a single larger object. The methods in the generated object simply call the original methods in the underlying "delegate" objects.
items.translation: `Mixin` 允许多个对象组合成一个更大的单一对象。生成的对象中的方法只是调用底层“委托”对象中的原始方法。
